fisherman.name: Fisherman
dialog: I hooked a real beauty off this beach this morning. Biggest catch of my life!
One good bite like that and I'm smiling for a week. That's why I keep coming back.

rich_boy.name: Rich Boy
dialog: Fling is a move that hurls whatever your Pokémon is holding straight at the foe.
Heavy things hit hardest, and some items do something rather odd when they land. Do experiment!

trainer.name: Brett
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Brett: Shh, you'll scare the fish away! ...Oh, all right. One quick battle.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Brett: Lost the battle and the fish. What a morning.

trainer.name: Alec
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Alec: Everyone laughs at a Magikarp. Nobody laughs at what it grows into!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Alec: Go on, then. You can laugh a little.

trainer.name: George
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman George: Four lines in the water, four Pokémon on the hook. Let's see which of them bites!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman George: Not so much as a nibble. Back to waiting.

trainer.name: Cole
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Cole: I reeled in two Gyarados off this very beach. Want to meet them?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Cole: Two Gyarados, and still you landed me.

trainer.name: Nicola
trainer.dialogueBefore: Beauty Nicola: The sea air does wonders for Lopunny's fur. Isn't it gorgeous? Now watch it move!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Beauty Nicola: Beaten, but still beautiful. That's what matters.

trainer.name: Conner
trainer.dialogueBefore: Tuber Conner: I can't swim yet, so I stay where my feet touch the bottom! Battle me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Tuber Conner: I'm not crying! It's just sea water!

trainer.name: Holly
trainer.dialogueBefore: Tuber Holly: My Remoraid squirts water at anybody who comes close. Here it comes!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Tuber Holly: Now I'm soaked too. I don't mind. It's the beach!

trainer.name: Trey
trainer.dialogueBefore: Rich Boy Trey: I'm on my way to see Sunyshore's famous lighthouse. You'll do as a little entertainment.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Rich Boy Trey: How tiresome. I shall need a long rest at the hotel.

trainer.name: Luther
trainer.dialogueBefore: Sailor Luther: A good sailor keeps a Pokémon for the sky, one for the deck and one for the sea. Meet my crew!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Sailor Luther: The whole crew overboard! Abandon ship!

trainer.name: Marc
trainer.dialogueBefore: Sailor Marc: Ahoy! My shipmate's a small one, but it rides the waves like a champion!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Sailor Marc: Small ones grow. Next time we meet, it'll have grown.

trainer.name: Thomas
trainer.dialogueBefore: Policeman Thomas: People get up to all sorts once the sun goes down. Let's see what you're up to!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Policeman Thomas: No trouble-maker, just a strong trainer. Carry on, and get home safely.
